maya: Heads up — seeing a spike in schema_rejects for fncall flows and they're appearing in billing as tool invocations. snippet attached.

maya: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": ["query string"]}}
```

maya: our validator expects args to be an object not an array, so adapter never ran but Console surfaces it as a charged tool call.

sam: ouch. paste the exact validator error?

maya: validator: `type_mismatch: expected object got array at /tool_call/args`

chris: ok that matches routing logic — we mark these as fncall-reject and they currently fall through to the degen route. billing path: root invoke counted, and later a route tag `tool_run_attempted` gets set by the adapter when it runs. if adapter never runs, attribution is wrong.

sam: policy question: should pre-adapter schema rejects be billed? i think no, but we need a deterministic audit-safe rule to avoid gaming.

chris: propose adding internal telemetry tags: `validation.outcome=reject_pre_adapter` and `billing.tool_executed=false` for those cases. record `validation.rule=shape_mismatch` for sampling.

maya: Console UX should show these as "Rejected before tool execution" (orange), include raw payload link and sample id. Ops currently sees cost spike and opens pages.

sam: rollout suggestion: 1) add internal tag `route.meta.billing_hold` (internal only), 2) canary 5% traffic where billing withheld on `reject_pre_adapter`, 3) sample and retain payloads 30d, 4) monitor abuse signals for 2 weeks, then flip.

chris: implementation note — don't add public API fields. Use internal route metadata and metrics only. Also add unit tests to assert `billing.tool_executed=false` when adapter not invoked (cover streaming and partial-parse cases).

maya: also need an alert: if schema_rejects spike AND billing increase in same 1h window, auto-create a triage card in Console. display affected routes and sample payloads.

ops-bot: deploy: starting canary rollout `invoke-validator-billing-hold` -> cluster eng-runtime-canary (5%). CI: 34 tests passed, 2 infra flakies. :rocket:

sam: i'll add metric `validation.rejected_pre_adapter.sampled` and a runtime flag to toggle sampling. will open PR for telemetry + tests.

chris: i'll review PR, add harness checks, and ensure analytics team can join for billing reconciliation.

maya: i'll create the Console ticket + mockups and write a short explainer for Support so they stop escalating. tagging console-ui for visibility. :thumbsup:
